title: Order
description: The canonical Order: the one shape every Channel is turned into, completed from the Product Catalog, recorded as an Accepted Order and turned into the Pick List (UC-001, UC-002, UC-003, UC-004). Trailhead Gear owns it. It holds every Order Check that concerns the Order alone, so a Rejected Order is never a valid Order; the Order Checks that need other data are named in the descriptions.

orderNumber.description: Order Number: `TG-` and four or more digits for a Partner Order, `PM-` and digits for a Peakmart Order (UC-003 BR-002). The Order Number Range (UC-003 BR-003), an Order Number already used (UC-003 BR-004) and a Duplicate (UC-001 BR-007, UC-002 BR-002) are checked against the Partner and the Order History.

partnerId.description: Partner that sent a Partner Order; only for the Channel `partner`. Checked against the API Key, UC-001 BR-002.

eventId.description: Event id of the Order Event a Peakmart Order was first taken from; only for the Channel `peakmart`.

orderedAt.description: Date and time the Customer placed the Order, with the offset the Channel sent.

receivedAt.description: Date and time the integration received the Order, in UTC; the 90 days of retention count from it (C-022).

correlationId.description: Correlation id carried by every log entry about the Order (NFR-013).

customerEmail.description: Email address of the Customer, when the Channel sent one. Personal data (C-021).

money.description: An amount of money: a string with two decimals next to its currency, never a JSON number.

currency.description: Currency; every price is in US dollars (C-020).

shippingAddress.description: Shipping Address, complete (UC-003 BR-007) and in the US or Canada (UC-003 BR-008). Personal data (C-021).

streetLine.description: Street line; several address lines are joined by ", " (UC-002 BR-007).

stateRegion.description: State or province, when the Channel sends one (UC-002 BR-007).

country.description: Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: the US or Canada (C-017).

orderLine.description: One Order Line, completed from the Product Catalog (UC-003 BR-011).

lineNumber.description: Number of the line within the Order, from 1.

sku.description: SKU of an Active Product, checked against the Product Catalog, UC-003 BR-009.

quantity.description: Number of items, 1 to 20; more is a Reseller (UC-003 BR-006).

unitPrice.description: Price of one item: the Catalog Price for a Partner Order (UC-001 BR-006), the Peakmart Price for a Peakmart Order (UC-002 BR-003).

productName.description: Product name from the Product Catalog.

unitWeightGrams.description: Weight of one item in grams from the Product Catalog.
